definitions: A device with a small spike or a spiked wheel that is worn on a rider's heel and used for urging a horse forward.
A projection from a mountain or hill.
A thing that prompts or encourages someone; an incentive.
A short, stiff, pointed projection on the leg of a male bird, especially a cock, used in fighting.
A branch from a main road or railway line.
examples: He dug his spurs into the horse's flanks.
The path followed a spur of the mountain.
The award was a spur to further effort.
A spur line connected the factory to the main railway.
